question: Classify fund names in published fund lists, starting with NYCT's 2025 annual report (all funds listed by name and year) and any other top-10 community foundation fund list, into company-named and person or family-named funds, to give a lower bound on corporate fund counts
conclusion_affected: Corporate share of DAF counts at community foundations (no sponsor in this pass publishes one)

question: Reconcile SVCF's audited corporate-advised and donor-advised grant lines (2021-2025) with its Form 990 Schedule D DAF grants and count, to establish whether Schedule D Part I includes corporate-advised funds; then apply the answer to other community foundations' Schedule D shares
conclusion_affected: Whether corporate-advised funds sit inside the Schedule D DAF totals used for market sizing
rationale: The audited lines and Schedule D grants do not move together. CY2024: Sch D $3,064m against audited donor-advised $3,077m plus corporate $189m. CY2022: Sch D $3,936m against $2,553m plus $175m. Grants-payable timing is a likely cause, but the inclusion of corporate funds is not established
